tool.name: BellaVista Interactive
tool.command: export BELLAVISTA_DIR=`pwd`/input/ && mkdir 'input' 'input/BellaVista_output' && chmod -R 777 'input/' && ln -s '$transcript_filename' './input/${transcript_filename.element_identifier}.${transcript_filename.ext}' && ln -s '$images' 'input/${images.element_identifier}.${images.ext}' && ln -s '$bellavista_config_file' './input/config.json' && #if $cell_segmentation: ln -s '$cell_segmentation' './input/${cell_segmentation.element_identifier}.${cell_segmentation.ext}' && #end if #if $nuclear_segmentation: ln -s '$nuclear_segmentation' './input/${nuclear_segmentation.element_identifier}.${nuclear_segmentation.ext}' && #end if #if $um_to_px_transform: ln -s '$um_to_px_transform' ./input/micron_to_mosaic_pixel_transform.csv && #end if cat ./input/config.json && /init

param.name: z_plane
param.label: z-plane of image to be visualize

param.name: selected_genes
param.label: Comma separated list of custom genes

param.name: transcript_point_size
param.label: Size of the points representing individual transcripts
